claims: No. 6 seed Tennessee defeated No. 11 seed Miami (Ohio) 78-56 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament first round on March 20, 2026, ending the RedHawks' season.
Ja'Kobi Gillespie led the Volunteers with 29 points.
Tennessee advances to play Virginia in the second round.
Ja'Kobi Gillespie scored 29 pts and made 6 threes for Tennessee.
J.P. Estrella scored 14 pts for Tennessee.
Felix Okpara scored 12 pts for Tennessee.
Peter Suder scored 27 pts for Miami (Ohio).
Miami (Ohio) concluded a season after a First Four win.
